question: What year-over-year revenue growth rate will Amazon report for its AWS segment in Q3 2026?

calls.reasoning: Q3'25 base $33.0B; each $0.33B = 1pt. Q2'26 grew 36.7% to $42.2B after +$4.6B QoQ (record), accelerating from ~28% in Q1. Sell-side estimates: HSBC $45.1B/36.8%, cited consensus ~38%, TD Cowen 41%, buy-side hopes 43-45%, with some articles citing 30-35%. Capacity-constrained with $496B backlog and big capacity adds, so I lean slightly above consensus. Repeating Q2's +$4.6B add gives ~42%; a normal +$2.5-3B gives ~36-38%. No matching human market found (Polymarket only has an EPS-beat market).
calls.dossier:
- Q3 2025 AWS net sales $33.0B (base; each $0.33B of Q3'26 sales = 1pp growth). Q2 2025 $30.9B (+17.5%).
- Q2 2026 AWS $42.2B, +36.7% YoY, fastest in 18 quarters; QoQ add ~$4.6B, ~80% larger than any prior quarterly add (Investing.com transcript / CNBC, Jul 30 2026). Q1 2026 growth ~28% (HSBC note via techflowpost, Oct 12 2026).
- AWS backlog $496B at Q2, up from $364B one quarter earlier; much of it is OpenAI/Anthropic commitments (techtimes Jul 31 2026; drillr preview).
- Jassy: not enough capacity to meet demand in 2026 or 2027; AI power capacity to double by end-2027 vs 2025; 7-8 GW net new capacity late 2025 to late 2027 (HSBC/drillr).
- Amazon gives no AWS-specific guidance; total Q3 guidance $197-202B in sales, $22.5-26.5B operating income; capex ~$220B for 2026 (Seeking Alpha).
- HSBC (Oct 12 2026): Q3 AWS $45.1B, +36.8% YoY.
- TD Cowen: Q3 AWS growth 41% YoY (Investing.com).
- Motley Fool (Oct 16 2026): analysts expect 30-35% YoY in Q3. Question background: consensus ~38%; BNP says investors look for 43-45%.
- Drillr: about $44.56B needed to hold 35% growth; Q2 AWS margin included ~$600M energy-derivative gain (affects margin, not sales).
- AI business and custom chips each above $25B run rate; chip run rate up from ~$5B at the start of the year.
- Reference class: during the 2025-26 reacceleration, AWS growth changed +2.5pp (Q2->Q3 2025), +~4pp, +~4pp, then +9pp (Q1->Q2 2026) quarter to quarter.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off the AWS segment net-sales figures in Amazon's Q3 2026 release (Oct 29 2026), computed exactly, not off the rounded headline percentage.
- Event window: the quarter ended Sep 30 2026, already finished; the number is set and only the release (Oct 29) remains. As of Oct 19, 100% of the quarter has elapsed and the release is 10 days away.
- Searched, absent: Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold market on AWS growth (only a Polymarket AMZN EPS-beat market found); an exact FactSet/Visible Alpha AWS consensus figure.

calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on all hard figures (Q3'25 $33.0B; Q2'26 $42.2B / 36.7%; backlog $496B; HSBC $45.1B). The only factual dispute was the consensus level: ~38% per the question background versus 30-35% per Motley Fool. Without web access I cannot date the Fool figure; it is likely stale, from before the Q2 beat, so I treated it as a small extra weight on the downside tail. The remaining question, whether Q3's sequential gain matches seasonal norms or Q2's record, is a judgment call. Capacity additions and the recent pattern of beats push me to a median slightly above consensus at 39.0. I adopted the runs' dispersion (~7-8). No escape mass is priced, because the quarter has ended and no mechanism takes the result outside 25-55.
